name: Mar, Graveyard Grifter

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Deep Cover
traits.details: When Mar uses change shape to look like an undead creature, other undead creatures treat Mar as if he were undead.

traits.name: Grifter's Advantage
traits.details: Mar deals 2d6 extra damage against any creature granting combat advantage to him. This extra damage increases to 3d6 if Mar is flanking the creature with an undead ally.

effect.description: Mar alters his physical form to appear as a Medium living or undead humanoid until he uses change shapeagain or until he drops to 0 hit points. To assume a specific individual’s form, Mar must have seen that individual. Other creatures can make a DC 28 Insight check to discern that the form is a disguise.

miss.description: Half damage, and the target falls prone.

powers.name: Horde's Defense
powers.trigger: Mar’s movement triggers an attack against him.

effect.description: The attack instead targets one of Mar’s undead allies adjacent to the attacker.
